name: Yaotome Hanae
source:
The first thing those close to her would mention about her would be her love of sexual jokes (obsessive, insistent, and uncontrollable) and the second would be her compassion.  Her capacity for empathy and her strong moral compass are central aspects to her character.

She is the oldest member of the Preppers Club, and she generally ends up being the mood-maker.  It is hard to tell where the clowning ends and the seriousness begins with her.
